findings:
🟠 [terminal-receipt-drift] MUST-FIX `runPanel` applies the new behaviour to the terminal panel in every mode: base emitted `verdict: 'SHIP-AS-IS'` whenever reviewed, head emits the first non-SHIP seat verdict plus new `success`, `packet_hash`, and (not-reviewed) `reason`/`phase` keys, so a `single`/no-snapshot campaign whose terminal panel has a FIX-THEN-SHIP seat produces a different `final_panel` receipt and feeds a different verdict into `final_adjudicate`, breaking §1.1.2 ("terminal receipt unchanged in shape") and §2.6 byte-identity; `station_single_control` only compares two head runs to each other and never to base, so nothing pins it. Smallest fix: gate `aggregatedVerdict`, `success`, `packet_hash`, `reason`/`phase` on `stationKind === 'panel'` (keep the terminal branch byte-identical) and add a base-fixture receipt comparison for the `single` control.
🟠 [single-gate-identity] MUST-FIX In `single` mode `gateInput` now carries `station: 'single'` and `lastReview` gains `success`, `station`, `candidate_tree_sha`, `reviewer_roster_digest`, `packet_hash`; the `full_diff_review` gate identity (and the `joint_review` `full_diff_payload_digest` if `stableReviewGatePayload` digests the whole object) no longer matches a pre-cut journal, so an in-flight 2-B campaign re-dispatches its review on resume after the upgrade (§1.1.3) and single-mode gate journal/receipts are not byte-identical (§2.6). Smallest fix: spread `station` into `gateInput` and the extra `lastReview` keys only when `reviewStation === 'panel'`.
🟠 [reuse-requires-two-seats] MUST-FIX `stationPanelReuse` requires `final_panel_seat_receipts.length > 1`, so a sealed panel of one seat (`min_panel_size: 1`, the state-suite fixture and a legal 2-B roster) is reviewed by the station and then fanned out again at `final_panel`: a second panel spend on the final candidate, forbidden by §1.1.2/§2.6. Smallest fix: change the guard to `length >= 1` (quorum is already enforced by `reviewed === true`).
🟡 [dropped-2b-assert] MUST-FIX `implementation-campaign-state.test.sh` replaced the `incomplete_roster_no_snapshot=true` shell assertion with `review_station_snapshot=true` instead of adding it, removing the 2-B pin that an incomplete roster never gets a snapshot. Smallest fix: restore the removed `assert_contains` line alongside the new one.
🔵 [prepare-review-in-panel] CUT/FOLLOW-UP In panel mode `preparedReview` is still computed and then discarded; if `prepareReview` builds the single-seat packet that is a wasted build, but it is cost not correctness and belongs to the `shared-packet` deliverable.
🔵 [reuse-not-journaled] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Terminal reuse builds `terminalReview` from `lastReview` without writing a `joint_review` gate entry, so a resume landing after `final_panel` fans out fresh; §1.1.2 explicitly allows a fresh dispatch on resume, so excluded.
🔵 [doc-whitespace] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `hetero-impl-loop.md` (both copies) now has four stray spaces before "Panel seats"; cosmetic, mirrors match so the sync check passes.
🔵 [identity-body-unused] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `qcPanelSnapshotIdentityBody` is exported but unused; the 2-B "fields present" rule is implemented inline in intake and `runPanel` instead. Dead export, not a defect.
